output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function always uses the setPrices function to set the sellPrice and buyPrice, but never checks the balance to make sure it is a valid buy price.

The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated by multiplying the sellPrice with the number of items sold, but the owner's balance is never checked to make sure it is a valid sell price.
